obj: Yes. The visit and the report cost nothing and do not commit you to anything. If you subscribe later, it starts from 170 SAR per unit a month with everything listed above included, on a yearly contract billed monthly.
How do I know the work gets done?
Every job comes with before and after photos, and you approve it in the app. If it is not right, it goes back to the team.
Do you work with individual residents?
No. We contract with the property owner or the owners' association for the whole building, from under 20 units to over 150. Residents then report issues from their phone, with no app to download.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Ameen collects and uses personal data through this website and the Ameen app, in line with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).
sections: What we collect

When you book a free inspection: your name, mobile number, city, property type, number of units and the services you are interested in. When you use the app: your phone number, language, the sites and units linked to you, requests you report, photos taken during jobs, and payment records.
Why we use it

To arrange and carry out the inspection, send you the report, provide the services in your contract, send service and payment notifications, and keep records the law requires. We do not send marketing messages without your separate consent.
Who we share it with

Only with those who help us deliver the service: the field service companies who do the work at your site, our hosting and messaging providers (for example WhatsApp for reminders), and licensed payment gateways. We do not sell personal data.
Where it is stored and for how long
We aim to store data in Saudi Arabia. We keep inspection requests for up to 24 months if no contract follows, and contract records for as long as the law requires.
Your rights
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent, at any time. Contact us and we will reply within 30 days.
Contact
Email tryameen.sa@gmail.com or message @tryameen.sa on Instagram.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms apply to this website, the free inspection, and the Ameen app.
sections: The free inspection

The inspection visit and the report are free and do not commit you to anything. We agree on a visit time with you, and the report is sent to the mobile number you give us, usually within 48 hours of the visit.
What the report is
The report records what our team saw on the day of the visit. It is not an engineering certificate, a safety certification or a guarantee of the condition of the property.
Services and billing
Ongoing services are provided under a separate written contract, which sets out the services, prices and response times. Contracts are yearly and billed monthly unless agreed otherwise.
Using the app
Keep your sign-in code private and use the app only for your own sites and units. Photos and reports in the app belong to the property owner or manager who contracts with us.
Liability
We are responsible for the work we agree to do under your contract. We are not responsible for problems that existed before our work or that fall outside the agreed scope.
Governing law
These terms are governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
Contact
Email tryameen.sa@gmail.com or message @tryameen.sa on Instagram.
